definitions.explanation: A student in their first year of a given school level — elementary first-grader, first-year junior high or high school student, or first-year university student. The school level is clarified by context or by prefixing it (e.g., {小学|しょうがく}{一年生|いちねんせい}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{一年生|いちねんせい}だ。
examples.english: My son is in first grade now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{一年生|いちねんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出会|であ}った→出会う：02298_deau⟧。
examples.english: We met when I was a freshman in university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学|しょうがく}→小学：29351_shougaku⟧{一年生|いちねんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦ランドセル→ランドセル：11191_randoseru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{背負|せお}って→背負う：16159_seou⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}い→通う：01217_kayou⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: When you become a first-grader, you start going to school carrying a randoseru backpack.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧ (one year) + {生|せい} (student). Can refer to any first-year level, with the school type either prefixed or understood from context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小学|しょうがく}→小学：29351_shougaku⟧{一年生|いちねんせい}: first-grader (elementary)
- ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧{一年生|いちねんせい}: first-year junior high student
- ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧{一年生|いちねんせい}: first-year high school student
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{一年生|いちねんせい}: university freshman
- {一年生|いちねんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a first-year student

USAGE:
Can also describe a beginner or newcomer in any field, e.g., ⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧{一年生|いちねんせい} (someone in their first year of working life).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{二年生|にねんせい}→二年生：27586_ninensei⟧: second-year student
- ⟦{三年生|さんねんせい}→三年生：27560_sannensei⟧: third-year student
- ⟦{新入生|しんにゅうせい}→新入生：03073_shinnyuusei⟧: new student (just entered)
